pull_request.body:
<!-- uv-lifecycle-closure: actions-hardening -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: project-identity-v2-compat-reader -->

## Goal

Perform the mechanical D-038 post-merge lifecycle closure for `actions-hardening` after PR #86 merged as `975a64855a739398139c90a094bdde9435542299`.

## Changes

- set `ACTIVE_SLICE.json` to `idle` with `active_slice: null`;
- record `actions-hardening` / PR #86 / merge `975a64855a739398139c90a094bdde9435542299` as `last_completed`;
- synchronize `PROJECT_STATE.md` to the accepted merged Actions-security boundary and final review/CI evidence;
- append PR #86 to `PROJECT_HISTORY.md`;
- synchronize `docs/architecture/CURRENT_ARCHITECTURE.md` and `docs/architecture/UV_STUDIO_V2_ARCHITECTURE_MAP.md` so current authorities classify `actions-hardening` as merged and `project-identity-v2-compat-reader` as next;
- keep the next handoff unchanged as `project-identity-v2-compat-reader`.

## Verification

Require the repository's five permanent CI checks on exact closure head `83519bb733202b9148a974c7bedc7716bef8483b`. The architecture-document synchronization addresses the concrete closure-consistency review finding without changing runtime, security, process or acceptance semantics. This remains a mechanical D-038 closure and does not require a new independent semantic review.

## Architecture impact

No architecture behavior changes. The two current architecture authorities are synchronized to the already-merged PR #86 and existing next-slice declaration so fresh bootstrap cannot direct work back to completed `actions-hardening`.

## Known limitations

The previously documented timing-sensitive `ProductionWorkspacePanel` remount race remains separate and unchanged. Repository-level enforcement of full-SHA Actions policy remains an owner-setting follow-up after this closure merges.

## Next task

Keep `project-identity-v2-compat-reader` as the sole declared handoff. Start it only from lifecycle-closed `main` after the repository-level full-SHA Actions policy is enabled when available and the mandatory fresh bootstrap is rerun.
